findings.title: WebSocket state_update messages overwrite reading state as a full snapshot, clearing the initial HTTP 15-minute forecast to null ('unknown') when the backend WebSocket payload omits predicted_load_15min.
findings.body: [ui-dashboard/src/App.tsx:195-203] In ui-dashboard/src/App.tsx:195-203 and ui-dashboard/src/cognitiveReading.ts:61-74, mapRealtimeState treats every state_update message as a complete snapshot rather than merging partial fields. As documented in claudedocs/design/ui-dashboard-audit-2026-10-30.md:118-125, services/adhd_engine/core/engine.py does not currently publish predicted_load_15min in state_update payloads, so the 15-minute forecast displays after the initial GET /api/adhd-state and then transitions to 'unknown' on the first WebSocket update. OPERATOR: left as is on 2026-10-30 (no fix commit; not accepted as risk).
